description: This source file defines the IImageImporter interface and helper classes related to image importing, processing, and handling image data within the PDFsharp library. It includes stream reading utilities, image information structures, and abstract classes for images and their data.

classes.name: StreamReaderHelper
classes.description: Helper class for dealing with stream data, providing methods to read bytes, words, double words, and manage stream position.

classes.name: ImportedImage
classes.description: Abstract class representing an imported image, providing methods to get image data for PDF and hold image information.

classes.name: ImageInformation
classes.description: Public information about the image, including dimensions, DPI, format, and color details.

classes.name: ImagePrivateData
classes.description: Abstract class that contains internal data for images, including references to the original imported image.

classes.name: ImageData
classes.description: Abstract class representing the data needed for embedding images in PDFs, to be prepared on demand.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Imports an image from a stream, returning an ImportedImage or null if unsupported.

methods.name: PrepareImage
methods.description: Prepares image data for inclusion in a PDF, given internal private data.
